targets.title: Extreme Weather Events Cause Significant Crop Yield Losses at the Farm Level in German Agriculture.
targets.evidence_quote: We conceptually replicate the wheat results in SOSFF, noting that SOSFF has a higher spatial farm information resolution.
targets.outcome_quote: In this study, we conceptually replicate Schmitt et al. (2022 ) in terms of direction and magnitude, focusing exclusively on the results for winter wheat.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion gives an overall positive verdict in direction and magnitude, after correcting location assignment. Standard coarse-resolution estimates do not fully replicate, and some regional comparisons differ. Following rule 1, prioritize the final overall verdict; uncertainty reflects its limited scope.

reasoning: Uses a different EU FADN sample and time window from the original national FADN sample, so replication despite discussion of computational reproduction. Original farm data were inaccessible; weather-code reconstruction is not a reanalysis of original farm outcomes. Reference as rendered lists Schmitt J. only.
